title: Citibike Jersey City 2025
text:
Project Objective & Workflow

Automated Data Pipeline:

Ingesting, cleaning, and merging 2025 Citi Bike monthly trips (~1.26M+ records) with Open-Meteo weather data and Jersey City GeoJSON boundaries.

Spatial & Database Integration:

Storing structured data and spatial geometries in a containerized PostgreSQL/PostGIS database using Docker and SQLAlchemy.

Advanced Analytics & Visualization:

Building optimized Materialized Views with spatial indices to power high-performance interactive Tableau dashboards.

title: Citibike Jersey City 2025
text:
Technical Challenges

Data Volume & Complexity:

Processing 12 monthly Citi Bike CSV files (~1.26M+ records)

Handling missing or inconsistent coordinate data and timestamps

Merging spatial GeoJSON boundaries with tabular ride data

Integration & Performance:

Combining asynchronous Weather API records with daily bike trips

Optimizing database queries using PostGIS spatial indexing
Building efficient Materialized Views and .hyper extracts for Tableau

title: Citibike Jersey City 2025
text:
Pipeline Architecture & Workflow

Automation: Python scripts handling extraction, cleaning, and transformation.
Storage: Containerized PostgreSQL/PostGIS for robust geospatial querying.
Visualization: Interactive dashboard for actionable urban mobility insights.

title: Citibike Jersey City 2025
text:
Project Motivation

Understanding Urban Mobility:

How do weather conditions (temperature, rain, wind) impact daily ridership in Jersey City?
What are the primary usage patterns distinguishing annual members from casual riders?

Spatial & Temporal Insights:

Identifying top start and end neighborhoods and high-traffic station clusters.
Analyzing peak hours, days of the week, and seasonal trends throughout 2025.

title: Citibike Jersey City 2025
text:
Key Analytical Questions

Weather Correlation: Does precipitation significantly drop casual trip durations compared to members?
Infrastructure Usage: Which stations require better capacity management based on spatial clustering?
